title: Aviyan Pandey
text:
Exploring Belowground Processes in a Changing World Soil ecology · Biogeochemistry · Sustainable agriculture


My research focuses on understanding how interactions among plants, soils, microorganisms, and environmental factors regulate ecosystem processes. I am particularly interested in the following research areas:

Soil Ecology and Biogeochemistry
Carbon and Nitrogen Cycling
Plant–Soil–Microbe Interactions
Rhizosphere Ecology and Belowground Carbon Allocation
Global Change and Ecosystem Responses
Plant Resource Acquisition under Environmental Stress
Sustainable and Climate-Resilient Agroecosystems




Colorado State University | Fort Collins, CO
PhD in Soil and Crop Sciences | May 2026 – Present Thesis: Evaluating Plant Belowground Strategies for Nitrogen Acquisition Across Water and SOM Gradient
Tennessee State University | Nashville, TN
MS in Environmental Sciences | Jan 2024 – Dec 2025
Thesis: Interactive Effects of Warming and Nitrogen Fertilization on Soil Respiration and Microbial Community Function
Tribhuvan University | Lamjung, Gandaki
BS in Agricultural Sciences | June 2018 – Dec 2022 Thesis: Effect of Nitrogen and Zinc on Performance of Mungbean (Vigna radiata) during Summer Planting in Sundarbazar Lamjung



Graduate Research Assistant | Colorado State University | May 2026 – Present
Root functional plasticity, Rhizosphere carbon dynamics, Nitrogen acquisition, Stable isotope labeling
Research Technician | Colorado State University | Mar 2026 – May 2026
Stable isotope labeling, Multi-pot isotope chamber, Research instrumentation
Graduate Research Assistant | Tennessee State University | Jan 2024 – Dec 2025
Soil carbon and nitrogen cycling, Microbial functional responses, Environmental stress






Stable isotope tracing (¹³C and ¹⁵N), soil CO₂ efflux measurements, microbial biomass C and N, extracellular enzyme assays, soil organic matter fractionation



Field-based global change experiments, controlled-environment experimentation, multifactorial experimental design, water and nutrient manipulation, plant and root phenotyping



R programming, linear and generalized linear mixed-effects models, multivariate analysis, machine learning, scientific data visualization, reproducible workflows
